```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R/dashboard_helpers.R"))
library(reactable)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(
  dbdir = here::here("data", "london_air.duckdb"), read_only = TRUE, shared_home = FALSE
))

# The dashboard runs the project's SQL queries directly. A query that has not
# been written yet returns NULL and its cards show a note instead.
run_sql <- function(file) {
  path <- here::here("sql", file)
  if (file.exists(path)) DBI::dbGetQuery(con, readr::read_file(path)) else NULL
}

trends <- run_sql("02_trends.sql")
latest <- run_sql("01_borough_latest.sql")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)

# Reference lines for the trend chart, each with its source (verified values only)
refs_path <- here::here("data", "reference", "air_quality_targets.csv")
refs <- if (file.exists(refs_path)) {
  readr::read_csv(refs_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |> filter(show_on_trend_chart)
} else {
  tibble(value = numeric(), label = character())
}

waiting <- function(file) {
  tags$p(class = "placeholder-note", paste0("Waiting for sql/", file, "."))
}

if (!is.null(trends)) {
  year_first <- min(trends$year)
  year_last  <- max(trends$year)
  pick <- function(group, yr, col) trends[[col]][trends$area_group == group & trends$year == yr]

  london_pm25_first <- pick("London", year_first, "pm25")
  london_pm25_last  <- pick("London", year_last, "pm25")
  england_pm25_last <- pick("England", year_last, "pm25")
  london_af_last    <- pick("London", year_last, "attributable_pct")
  england_af_last   <- pick("England", year_last, "attributable_pct")

  trend_long <- trends |>
    filter(area_group %in% c("London", "England")) |>
    transmute(year, series = area_group, value = pm25)

  trend_title <- sprintf(
    "London's PM2.5 %s from %s µg/m³ in %d to %s in %d, %s England's %s",
    if (london_pm25_last < london_pm25_first) "fell" else "rose",
    fmt_num(london_pm25_first), year_first, fmt_num(london_pm25_last), year_last,
    if (london_pm25_last > england_pm25_last) "still above" else "below",
    fmt_num(england_pm25_last)
  )
  trend_alt <- paste0(
    "Line chart of annual mean PM2.5 from ", year_first, " to ", year_last, ". ",
    "London (population-weighted) goes from ", fmt_ugm3(london_pm25_first), " to ", fmt_ugm3(london_pm25_last), "; ",
    "England goes from ", fmt_ugm3(pick("England", year_first, "pm25")), " to ", fmt_ugm3(england_pm25_last), ".",
    if (nrow(refs) > 0) paste0(" Reference lines: ", paste(refs$label, collapse = "; "), ".") else ""
  )
}

if (!is.null(latest)) {
  ranked <- latest |> filter(!is_city_of_london)
  lowest  <- ranked |> slice_min(pm25, n = 1)
  highest <- ranked |> slice_max(pm25, n = 1)
}
```

# Overview

## Row {height="190px"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr if (!is.null(trends)) paste0("London PM2.5 in ", year_last, " (England ", fmt_ugm3(england_pm25_last), ")") else "London PM2.5"
list(
  icon = "wind",
  color = "light",
  value = if (!is.null(trends)) fmt_ugm3(london_pm25_last) else "Waiting for sql/02_trends.sql"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr if (!is.null(trends)) paste0("Deaths at 30+ attributable to PM2.5, ", year_last, " (England ", fmt_pct(england_af_last), ")") else "Deaths attributable to PM2.5"
list(
  icon = "heart-pulse",
  color = "light",
  value = if (!is.null(trends)) fmt_pct(london_af_last) else "Waiting for sql/02_trends.sql"
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr if (!is.null(latest)) paste0("PM2.5 range across the 32 boroughs, ", lowest$pm25_year, ", µg/m³ (City of London excluded)") else "Range across boroughs"
list(
  icon = "arrows-expand",
  color = "light",
  value = if (!is.null(latest)) paste0(fmt_num(lowest$pm25), " to ", fmt_num(highest$pm25)) else "Waiting for sql/01_borough_latest.sql"
)
```

## Row {height="560px"}

### Column {width=68%}

```{r}
#| title: !expr if (!is.null(trends)) trend_title else "PM2.5 over time"
if (!is.null(trends)) {
  chart_card(
    trend_chart(trend_long, refs, y_title = "Annual mean PM2.5 (µg/m³)"),
    alt = trend_alt,
    source = paste(
      "Source: OHID Fingertips indicator 93867 (Defra modelled PM2.5, population-weighted).",
      "London is the mean of the 33 London areas weighted by each year's ONS mid-year population."
    )
  )
} else {
  waiting("02_trends.sql")
}
```

### Column {width=32%}

```{r}
#| title: PM2.5 by year (µg/m³)
if (!is.null(trends)) {
  trends |>
    filter(area_group %in% c("London", "England")) |>
    select(year, area_group, pm25) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = area_group, values_from = pm25) |>
    select(year, London, England) |>
    reactable(
      columns = list(
        year = colDef(name = "Year"),
        London = colDef(name = "London (µg/m³)", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
        England = colDef(name = "England (µg/m³)", format = colFormat(digits = 1))
      ),
      compact = TRUE, highlight = TRUE,
      style = list(fontVariantNumeric = "tabular-nums")
    )
} else {
  waiting("02_trends.sql")
}
```

# Boroughs

::: {.card title="Coming in session 3"}
A map of PM2.5 in 2024, a ranked bar chart of the share of deaths attributable to PM2.5, and a searchable table of every borough. The City of London will be flagged and left out of rankings because its resident population is small.
:::

# Deprivation

::: {.card title="Coming in session 3"}
IMD score against PM2.5 for each borough, with the correlation. This is an ecological comparison: inner boroughs are both denser and, in many cases, more deprived.
:::

# Respiratory admissions

::: {.card title="Coming in session 3"}
Asthma admissions (under 19) and COPD admissions (35+) against PM2.5. Descriptive only, not causal. For both indicators Fingertips combines the City of London with Hackney.
:::

# What a 1 µg/m³ cut is worth

::: {.card title="Coming in sessions 2 and 3"}
QALYs gained and break-even annual spend for each borough from a sustained 1 µg/m³ cut in PM2.5, with sensitivity analysis and the full list of assumptions.
:::

# Methods and sources

::: {.card title="Data sources"}
- OHID Fingertips API, upper-tier local authorities (area type 502): PM2.5 concentration (93867), fraction of mortality attributable to PM2.5 (93861), asthma admissions under 19 (90810), COPD emergency admissions 35+ (92302), IMD 2019 score (93553). <https://fingertips.phe.org.uk/>
- ONS mid-year population estimates by single year of age, via Nomis dataset NM_2002_1. <https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/>
- ONS National life tables, England, 2022 to 2024. <https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/birthsdeathsandmarriages/lifeexpectancies/datasets/nationallifetablesenglandreferencetables>
- Hernández Alava M, Pudney S, Wailoo A. Estimating EQ-5D by Age and Sex for the UK. NICE Decision Support Unit, 2022. <https://sheffield.ac.uk/nice-dsu/methods-development/estimating-eq-5d>
- ONS Open Geography Portal, Local Authority Districts (May 2026) Boundaries UK BUC.
